title: Hemoglobin, T state to R state

provenance.note: Human hemoglobin from one study, both at 1.25 Angstrom by X-ray diffraction: deoxy (T state, entry 2DN2) and oxy (R state, entry 2DN1). The coordinates are the prepared composite hemoglobin-tr-flipbook, built from its recipe: twelve chains, each its own state copy. Every atom is a deposited atom of 2DN2 or 2DN1 moved by one rigid-body transform: the 2DN2 chains are unmoved, the 2DN1 dimer and its assembly-operator copy are fitted on the T alpha 1 beta 1 pair, and the intermediate positions are fractions of the measured screw motion of the T alpha 2 beta 2 pair (14.1 degrees about one axis, 1.3 Angstrom along it). Waters and the two toluene molecules of 2DN1 are left out. The path between the two deposited structures is illustrative; only the T and R end points are measured. Dashed lines show measured heavy-atom distances.

chapters.title: T state, no oxygen
chapters.caption: Human deoxyhemoglobin, entry 2DN2, X-ray structure at 1.25 Å: the T state, with no bound oxygen. Four subunits, each with one heme. Green: the alpha 1 beta 1 pair. Blue: the alpha 2 beta 2 pair. Gold: iron.

immersive.narration: Deoxyhemoglobin, T state: four subunits, four hemes, no bound oxygen.

chapters.title: R state, oxygen bound
chapters.caption: Human oxyhemoglobin, entry 2DN1, X-ray structure at 1.25 Å: the R state. Violet: alpha 1 beta 1, placed on the T pair. Amber: alpha 2 beta 2, turned 14.1 degrees from its T position. One O2 (white) is on each heme.

immersive.narration: This is oxyhemoglobin, the R state: O2 on every heme.

chapters.title: T and R overlaid
chapters.caption: Green and blue: T. Violet and amber: R. With alpha 1 beta 1 fitted (green over violet), alpha 2 beta 2 in R (amber) is turned 14.1 degrees about one axis and shifted 1.3 Å along it. Its alpha carbons lie 5.2 Å RMS from their T positions (blue). The two dashed lines are contacts where the two pairs meet, across the alpha 1 beta 2 interface: in T, alpha 1 Tyr 42 to beta 2 Asp 99, 2.51 Å; in R, alpha 1 Asp 94 to beta 2 Asn 102, 2.83 Å.

immersive.narration: Overlaid: one subunit pair is turned 14 degrees from its T position.

chapters.title: Iron and oxygen
chapters.caption: One alpha 1 heme: T (green) over R (violet). Gold: iron. In T the iron is 0.39 Å above the plane of the four ring nitrogens, toward His 87. In R it is 0.04 Å from that plane, with O2 1.82 Å from the iron. The other dashed line measures 2.70 Å between O2 and His 58.

immersive.narration: Iron: 0.4 Å above in T; within 0.05 Å of the plane in R.
